== Description ==
'''D-120''' is the sixth entity you will encounter throughout the D-Section. It acts almost the exact same as A-120 and A-200, except being much deadlier, as you'll see throughout this page. More information on '''D-120''' will be presented here. It is also the fourth scribble in all of Rooms: Found Footage, following A-200i and prescending M-120.

== Mechanic ==
D-120 will spawn behind the current rooms door making drumming sounds. After a bit, D-120 will backtrack though the rooms despawning after a bit. Any player seen by D-120 will get jumpscared and die. D-120 also blocks the door if you try to open it.

If [[Red Rooms]] is currently active, '''D-120''' will only give players 1,5 seconds to hide before fallbacking.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* Despite being a scribble, '''D-120''' will not come back for any players when they exit their lockers, and it will additionally not rebound on its own. This means that if '''D-120''' passes you, it is safe to leave your locker and continue progression.
* If [[D-60i]] is active, you should proceed to the main room cearfuly as '''D-120''' might spawn when [[D-60i]] breaks the door, so you should look for screenshake or pay very attention to '''D-120'''<nowiki/>'s ambience to avoid getting caught by surprise and killed by '''D-120'''.
* When '''D-120''' spawns out of the [[Red Rooms]], it is best to remain hidden for a few seconds, because [[D-60]] might be comming, and '''D-120''' can make it difficult to hear its sound, or just hide in the previous room.
* If '''D-120''' spawn in the room with shelves in the [[Section D|D section]]'s derelict, is best to hide in the previous room, as in this room the lockers are too far away, and if you go to a broken locker without noticing, you probably won't have enough time to move to another locker and will be killed by '''D-120'''.

* '''D-120'''<nowiki/>'s kill radius is longer than most entities, so it is best to wait until it is at least one room away.

* If you don't know if '''D-120''' is present, look for repetitive, almost rhythmic camera movement. This is because '''D-120''' shakes the camera based off of how loud its sound is. This can help you determine if '''D-120''' is close to you in case you cannot rely on audio cues, likely due to other entities blocking '''D-120'''<nowiki/>'s sounds.

* In the [[Red Rooms]], '''D-120''' poses a much greater threat due to its shortened wait time and faster speed. To counter this, you should open a door and immediately walk out of sight from the new room's door in case of '''D-120''' spawning. This gives you a bigger advantage, since '''D-120''' uses raycast.
** Once you do hear it, either rush into a locker by sprinting or enter a locker immediately after you hear its appearing sound.

== Trivia ==
* '''D-120''' and [[M-120]] are currently the only scribbles that doesn't rebound. And also the few entities that doesn't have any '''I variation''' currently.
* '''D-120''' is made of blood.
* '''D-120''' has an very low chance of getting replaced by [[SHA-120]].
* '''D-120''' has an Admin variant that is much faster and rebounds.
